notes: stage 5 cruise friction of mg90-d on dev-v006-2A-D: the friction line the velocity loop holds under the window term, from window-term/g3 (Velocity cruises at 300, 800, 1500 and 4025 c/s, both ways, g_window_q016 at the window-term result's field, friction 40 / 728 installed) and its repeat window-term/g3b on the refit words. Each leg's current-loop reference is replayed from its rows with the board's integer reading (settle gain, window term, the polled bias) and the set of record's loop gains and Ke; the held mean is the reading on read rows and the reference, averaged over its MEDIUM period, on the rest, over the leg's middle half. The line is a least squares fit of the held mean of the 18 whole legs at 300 to 1500 c/s and the one 4025 c/s leg whose speed held within 2 % across its steady rows, against the goal; coulomb_ma and viscous_ma_s_per_rad are what the set's rules read, the words report only. The repeat on the refit words grades it; the joint_* keys are both sittings fitted together, report only.

coulomb_ma.unit: mA, the line's intercept: the loop's held current at zero speed, se bounds

viscous_ma_per_kcps.unit: mA per 1000 count/s of the set's table, se bounds

viscous_ma_s_per_rad.unit: mA per motor rad/s, the same slope at the table's counts per degree and the gear ratio

counts_per_motor_rad.unit: table counts a motor radian the slope was converted at

fric_fc_counts.unit: the intercept in shunt counts, report: the set's rule gives the field

fric_fv_q016.unit: the slope in Q0.16 shunt counts per count/s, report
